title: Encoding a directed acyclic circuit
statement: For a circuit with $n$ input vertices, its encoding concatenates the unary encoding of $n$, the list encoding of its gates, and the unary encoding of its output vertex. The gates are listed in topological order, each gate reads only vertices with index less than $n+i$ when it is the $i$th gate, and the output index is less than $n$ plus the number of gates.
hypotheses_covered: The circuit has a natural-number input size $n$.
Each gate reads only vertices of index less than $n+i$ at gate position $i$.
The output index is less than $n$ plus the number of gates.
